noAds: No advertising or marketing tracking — ever. We never use cookies to build an ad profile, retarget you, or sell your data. Optional analytics, if you enable them, only help us improve {appName}.

summary.title: Your privacy, your choice
summary.body: We use essential cookies to keep the site running and, with your permission, optional analytics to understand how people use it. See our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.

details.title: Cookie preferences
details.body: Choose which cookies you allow. Essential cookies stay on. Full details are in our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.

essential.title: Essential
essential.description: Required for the site to work — security, session management, and core features. These cannot be turned off.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Helps us understand which pages people find useful and how the site performs, so we can keep improving it. Never used for advertising.
